**Comment on passage `HBHXV39P361A`:** [^comment-HBHXV39P361A-1]

```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="ZZBXV15P040C" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">

  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">

  </div>
</article>
```
```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="TKXXV04P261A" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Passage</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#TKXXV04P261A">TKXXV04P261A</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-TKXX" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Ibn Saʿd</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā</span></a>, vol. 4 p. 261</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    أخبرنا محمد بن عبيد الطنافسي قال حدثنا محمد بن إسحاق عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب عن مرثد بن عبد الله اليزني عن أبي عبد الرحمن الجهني قال بينا نحن عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذ طلع راكبان فلما رآهما قال كنديان مذحجيان حتى أتياه فإذا رجلان من مذحج فدنا أحدهما إليه ليبايعه فلما أخذ بيده قال يا رسول الله أرأيت من رآك فآمن بك وصدقك واتبعك ماذا له قال طوبى له فمسح على يده فانصرف. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 261 of vol. 4">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```
```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="THRAV05P197B" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Passage</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#THRAV05P197B">THRAV05P197B</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-THRA" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span></a>, vol. 5 p. 197</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    أخبرنا يحيى بن أبي الرجاء إجازة بإسناده عن ابن أبي عاصم حدثنا أبو بكر أنبأنا محمد بن عبيد أنبأنا محمد بن إسحاق عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب عن أبي الخير مرثد ابن عبد الله اليزني عن أبي عبد الرحمن الجهني قال بينا نحن عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذ طلع راكبان فلما رآهما قال كنديان مذحجيان فلما رآهما فإذا رجلان من مذحج فقال أحدهما حين أخذ بيده ليبايعه يا رسول الله أرأيت من رآك وآمن بك وصدقك ماذا له فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم طوبي له ثم طوبي له فماسحه ثم انصرف فأقبل الآخر فقال يا رسول الله أرأيت من لم يرك وصدقك وشهد أن ما جئت به هو الحق فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم طوبي له ثم طوبي له فماسحه ثم انصرف. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 197 of vol. 5">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```

```{=html}
  </div>
</article>
```

```{=html}
    حدثنا محمد بن عبيد حدثنا محمد بن إسحاق عن ثمامة قال خرجنا مع فضالة بن عبيد إلى أرض الروم وكان عاملا لمعاوية على الدرب فأصيب ابن عم لنا فصلى عليه فضالة وقام على حفرته حتى واراه فلما سوينا عليه حفرته قال أخفوا عنه فإن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يأمرنا بتسوية القبور. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 359 of vol. 39">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```

[^comment-HBHXV39P361A-1]: This is part of a series of traditions that appear to originate with Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd that discuss vomiting and its impact on the status of fasting. In this series there is a great deal of variation, but most suggest that Faḍālah was with the prophet and when someone offered him a drink or when he asked for a drink, Muḥammad was asked about the status of his fast. He replies generally that he was had been fasting but then vomited and was no longer fasting. In some traditions in the series there are comments about whether vomiting “breaks” the fast or if Muḥammad chose to end his fast after vomiting. There appears to be some dispute in the legal tradition about vomiting and its impact on the status of the fast, which these traditions address. The fragments are not separated into specific style types and are simply group by subject. They are witnessed by <a href="WHSDB.html" class="witness-link">WHSDB</a> (Ḥammād b. Salamah b. Dīnār al-Baṣrī): <a href="../references.html#ref-THSH" class="source-ref">THSHV04P379A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. [^comment-HBHXV39P359B-1]: This passage is not found in the redaction of Ibn Hishām. Abī Umayyah al-Īyādī al-Tanāfisī al-Kūfī): <a href="../references.html#ref-SHBM" class="source-ref">SHBMV03P024L</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Shaybah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Kitāb al-muṣannaf fī al-aḥāddīth waʾl-āthār</span>, vol. 3 p. 24); <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī): <a href="../references.html#ref-STBX" class="source-ref">STBXV18P313C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Ṭabarānī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Muʿjam al-kabīr</span>, vol. 18 p. 313) and <a href="../references.html#ref-BQSX" class="source-ref">BQSXV03P576E</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Bayhaqī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sunan al-kubrā</span>, vol. 3 p. 576); <a href="WABAB.html" class="witness-link">WABAB</a> (ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlā al-Shāmī al-Baṣrī): <a href="../references.html#ref-THSH" class="source-ref">THSHV08P320A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭaḥāwī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Sharḥ mushkil al-āthār</span>, vol. 8 p. 320) and <a href="../references.html#ref-SHBM" class="source-ref">SHBMV03P028G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Shaybah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Kitāb al-muṣannaf fī al-aḥāddīth waʾl-āthār</span>, vol. 3 p. 28); <a href="WMUTK.html" class="witness-link">WMUTK</a> (Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Umayyah ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Īyādī al-Ṭanāfisī al-Kūfī): <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV39P359B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 39 p. 359); and <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī): <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV39P362A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 39 p. 362) and <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHR" class="source-ref">KTHRV07P018B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Jāmiʿ al-masānīd waʾl-sunan</span>, vol. 7 p. 18). It is a part of a series of traditions that originate from Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd, related to Ibn Isḥāq through Thumāmah b. Shufayy. According to <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-ref">BKHBV02P177D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span>, vol. 2 p. 177), Abū ʿAlī Thumāmah b. Shufayy al-Hamdānī only related from a few people, including Faḍālah, ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir, and Qubayṣah b. Dhuʾayb. He appears to have been regarded as one of the people of Egypt. <a href="../references.html#ref-RZJX" class="source-ref">RZJXV02P466C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Jarḥ waʾl-taʿdīl</span>, vol. 2 p. 466) states that Thumāmah related material to Ibn Isḥāq as well as Yazīd b. Abī Ḥabīb, the source of the only clarification tradition in the group found on in the <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) witness; all other the other traditions come to Ibn Isḥāq directly through Thumāmah. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Aḥmad b. Yūnus al-Ṣadafī, in his history of Egypt, refers to him as Thumāmah b. Shufayy al-Hamdānī, as well as al-Uḥrūjī al-Miṣrī, although what “Uḥrūj” refers to in not known. al-Ṣadafī claims that Thumāmah participated in the raid on Rhodes (Rūdas) with Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd and that he died before 120/737 during the caliphate of Hishām b. ʿAbd al-Mālik (reign c. 724-743) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-TYNX" class="source-ref">TYNXV01P080A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Abū Saʿīd ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Aḥmad b. Yūnus al-Ṣadafī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh Ibn Yūnus al-Miṣrī</span>, vol. 1 p. 80)). al-Mizzī states that Thumāmah settled in Alexandria (<a href="../references.html#ref-MZTX" class="source-ref">MZTXV04P404A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>al-Mizzī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tahdhīb al-kamāl fī asmāʾ al-rijāl</span>, vol. 4 p. 404)). The tradition witnessed by <a href="WYUAU.html" class="witness-link">WYUAU</a> (Yaʿlā b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Umayyah al-Īyādī al-Tanāfisī al-Kūfī) and <a href="WMUTK.html" class="witness-link">WMUTK</a> (Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd b. Abī Umayyah ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Īyādī al-Ṭanāfisī al-Kūfī) (who were brothers and likely heard the story at the same time), state that the event took place in the time of Muʿāwiyah during the invasion of “Rūm” (see <a href="../references.html#ref-SHBM" class="source-ref">SHBMV03P024L</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Shaybah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Kitāb al-muṣannaf fī al-aḥāddīth waʾl-āthār</span>, vol. 3 p. 24) and <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV39P359B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 39 p. 359) respectively). <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) also states in one of the traditions he witnessed that it occurred during the invasion of “Rūm” but does not place it in a time period (see <a href="../references.html#ref-HBHX" class="source-ref">HBHXV39P362A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Aḥmad b. Ḥanbal</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Musnad</span>, vol. 39 p. 362)). According to Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ, the invasion of Rhodes occurred in 59/678-679, the last year of Muʿāwīyah’s reign, under the leadership of Junādah b. Abī Umayyah (see <a href="../references.html#ref-SFTX" class="source-ref">SFTXV01P227B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ al-Shaybānī al-ʿAṣfarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh</span>, vol. 1 p. 227)). There is, however, some dispute about the year that Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd died, some placing his death in 53, others in 67. Ibn Kathīr, quoting Ibn al-Jawzī, states that Faḍālah died in 55, apparently just before the capture of Rhodes, which he covers in the following section (see <a href="../references.html#ref-KTHB" class="source-ref">KTHBV08P078B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Kathīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Bidāyat waʾl-nihāyah</span>, vol. 8 p. 78)). If this is accurate, the tradition may have had a foreshadowing element since it talks about death and burial just before Faḍālah’s own death. Placement should be in the year 55 or 56 under the heading of the Invasion of Rhodes.
